claims.claim: Copperwheat Bakery supplies bread to its own stand at the Milbrook Green festival on Saturday 15 August 2026, and co-owner Sara Copperwheat staffs the stand from 8:00 AM.
Festival rules prohibit overnight storage of goods at stands, so the stand starts Saturday with no stock.
On Friday evening 14 August the bakery holds 20 finished festival loaves, baked that day and fully cooled, set aside for Saturday delivery.
The bakery's deck oven yields finished festival loaves at a measured 30 per hour when run in continuous batches.
Head baker Tomas Ilic is scheduled to run the oven exclusively on festival loaves from 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM on Saturday 15 August, after which the oven switches to the shop's regular trade.
Bakery procedure requires loaves to cool on racks for 60 minutes after leaving the oven before they may be crated for transport.
Driver Jo Fenwick is scheduled to make two van runs from the bakery to the green on Saturday, departing at 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM after a 10-minute load, with a 15-minute drive each way.
The van carries at most 90 crated loaves per run, and Fenwick's practice is to load every cooled festival loaf on hand up to that capacity.
claims.source: Van fitting note and prior festival runs

claims.claim: No bakery vehicle other than the two scheduled morning runs is due at the green before a 3:00 PM restock run.
Handover at the stand takes place immediately on the van's arrival at the green.
